title: spec(print page) ① of #8346: a `page` gains an optional `print` declaration, a linted printable-block subset, the list-export retirement sentence made true, and the three zero-reader document schemas retired
body:
Part of #8346. This is split card ① of the ruling `6051470224` (B′, maintainer 「8346 B′」, 2026-10-08T03:18Z, recorded by the director seat). Filed by the `domain:spec` seat 3 (seat post #18883, `session_01RPo7FUd6bSnAfkWMAKi848`), the design parent's holder. ⛔ Not a claim.

## The ruling this card executes (verbatim, from `6051470224`)

> **B′. A document is a page with a print declaration; no new template type.**
> - **The template is a `page`.** … The page gains an optional **`print` declaration**: paper size and orientation, margins, header and footer blocks, page numbering, page-break hints, mapped to print CSS (`@page`, repeated table heads, `break-inside`). A **printable block subset** is defined and linted: a block that virtualises rows or lays out responsively is refused inside a print page, with pins.
> - **The 17.0 retirement stands and its text changes.** List export does not regain `'pdf'`; the retirement sentence in `packages/spec/src/ui/list-view-export-options.ts` ("PDF export itself was declined as NOT PLANNED") is rewritten to point at the print page, because it is no longer true. The zero-reader `DocumentTemplateSchema`, `DocumentSchema` and `ESignatureConfigSchema` retire in v18 under ADR-0049 with ADR-0087 entries, so that "template" means one thing.
> - ⛔ **Not taken:** A (restoring `'pdf'` on list export …), B (a second authoring vocabulary beside pages …), C as the end state …, a Word-upload template kind, batch merging or packaged downloads …, and the in-process `pdfmake`-class driver.

The split, from the same ruling:
- ① spec (this card);
- ② objectui (`domain:ui`): the print CSS mapping, the printable blocks, the record page's print action;
- ③ the render service, the Chromium driver and the `service-storage` archive entry (`domain:services`);
- ④ the record-page "generate PDF" action and the attachment on the record.

"Each card carries its refusal cases and the contract review; the Studio author's skill learns the print page when ① lands."

## Scope of ① (spec only)

Read on `main` `fec87e7e0`:
1. **`print` on `PageSchema`** (`packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts:788`, a `strictObject`). Optional and closed:
   - paper size and orientation;
   - margins;
   - header and footer blocks (page blocks);
   - page numbering;
   - page-break hints.

   Every key is declared with a `.describe()` that names what it maps to in print CSS. ⛔ Nothing is declared that no renderer will honour: each key names its consumer, ② (browser print) and later ③ (the Chromium driver). Per the declared-equals-enforced rule, a key whose ② consumer does not exist yet is either left out of ① or recorded as a liveness-ledger row in `planned` naming ②.
2. **The printable block subset and its lint.** A block that virtualises rows or lays out responsively is refused inside a page that declares `print`, with its location, at the authoring doors (`os validate` / `os build` and the save door, per the existing page-block lint family). Pinned: each refused block type, plus a print page built only from printable blocks (record field blocks, static all-rows tables, text, images) that passes.
3. **The retirement sentence** in `packages/spec/src/ui/list-view-export-options.ts` (`:38`, "(PDF export itself was declined as NOT PLANNED) — no renderer has ever produced a PDF …") is rewritten to point at the print page. ⛔ `'pdf'` does not return to `exportOptions`.
4. **Three retirements under ADR-0049**, each with its ADR-0087 entry: `DocumentTemplateSchema`, `DocumentSchema` and `ESignatureConfigSchema` (`packages/spec/src/data/document.zod.ts`).
   - The claimant measures "zero readers" first, across the repo and objectui.
   - The `spec-property-retirement` skill (`.claude/skills/`) is the kit: tombstone or removal route, the liveness-ledger discipline, generated baselines, docs and pins.

## Contract notes for the claimant

- `Clause-②: yes`: `print` widens `PageSchema`'s public face. The retirements and the printable-subset refusal narrow, so the arm is `(narrowing)` and BREAKING with its ADR-0087 dispositions. The contract review is owed at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`.
- It may land in passes (for example the `print` declaration and lint first, the retirements second), each `Part of` this card.
- **Serial:** `page.zod.ts` and `document.zod.ts` are in the spec lane's hot surface. Read open PRs' file lists at claim.
